name: CouchElephant
description: Plex's DVR records the wrong broadcast. Ask it to record your team and it will happily pick the repeat that airs two days later, on a channel you do not watch, and tell you nothing about it. CouchElephant reads the same guide, picks the live broadcast itself, and pins the recording to that exact channel and start time so Plex has nothing left to choose. It sits beside Plex rather than replacing it, and recordings land in your Plex library exactly as they always did. It also adds passes Plex has no equivalent for. Follow any of 1,300 professional and college teams and it records every game they play. Or build a smart filter out of nested AND, OR and NOT conditions over genre, rating, channel, time and more. Every standard Plex recording option, padding included, is on every pass, and a new sports pass arrives with sensible padding already filled in. It watches Plex do its own job, too. When Plex stops refreshing its guide nothing breaks and nothing complains: passes keep running, syncs keep succeeding, and the guide gets a day shorter every day until what you wanted is past the end of it. CouchElephant checks every sync, and sends what it finds to Discord, Telegram or Notifiarr. Discord needs no bot, just a webhook URL from your own channel. Add as many destinations as you like and choose which events reach which one, so faults can go to one channel and recordings to another. It can also follow something the guide has not heard of yet. Plex's guide reaches about twelve days, and no guide source anywhere reaches much further, because no broadcaster has decided that far out. So a series announced for next spring, or the rest of your team's season, has no guide row to match. CouchElephant holds the intention, shows what it is waiting for, and turns it into a real recording the moment Plex's guide carries an airing. Nothing outside the guide ever books anything. Announced series come from TVmaze and a team's published season comes from TheSportsDB. Neither needs a key or an account, so a followed team fills in its whole season, months ahead, out of the box. Point it at your Plex server under Settings and nothing else is required. A new install starts in preview mode: it shows which airing each rule would take without writing anything to your DVR, so you can see it is right before you let it near the recorder.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: The database, your channel artwork, and any snapshots you schedule. The guide is a cache and rebuilds itself from Plex, so this stays small.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: The port the web interface listens on.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: The container's clock. Guide times are stored as UTC and shown in whichever timezone you pick under Settings, so this only affects the log.
